subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should OpenClaw accept one same-model/profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: The patch is coherent and proven, but it deliberately changes compatibility-sensitive fallback, auth-provider, and session-replay behavior that automation should not choose for maintainers.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout retry
options.body: Merge the PR with the one-retry policy because it avoids spending auth-profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout while preserving real auth/rate-limit fast failover.

options.title: Preserve immediate fallback semantics
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps first-time ordinary timeouts on the existing rotation/fallback path and addresses transient timeout noise elsewhere.

options.title: Split session repair first
options.body: Pause this PR until the aborted-leaf transcript repair lands independently, then revisit the timeout retry policy with less session-state coupling.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout retry
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the one-retry policy because it avoids spending auth-profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout while preserving real auth/rate-limit fast failover.
